entries.3c4a13eeced3378c: The largest business is the Machine Tool Business, with net sales to external customers of ¥58,332 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025. Next are the Industrial Machinery Business at ¥9,730 million, the Food Machinery Business at ¥6,952 million and Other Business at ¥5,557 million. By region, net sales were ¥27,156 million in Greater China, ¥23,157 million in Japan, ¥12,994 million in North and South America, ¥9,943 million in other Asia and ¥7,319 million in Europe. Within Greater China, China accounted for ¥23,870 million, and within North and South America, the United States accounted for ¥11,882 million. No customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
entries.54db77a3e710ea69: In addition to electrical discharge machines, micro-hole electrical discharge machines, machining centers, metal 3D printers and laser processing machines, it develops and manufactures injection molding machines, food machinery, precision molds and molded products, linear motor-applied products, ceramic products and others.
entries.6d3744d5d42a64ec: In January 2026, the company established a new philosophy framework and, under the purpose 'Creating the future of manufacturing with creativity and innovation,' shifted its medium-term management plan for the fiscal years from December 2026 to December 2029 to a commitment-type plan. Its policies are 'breaking away from dependence on the Chinese market,' 'selection and concentration,' 'rebuilding production and sales structures globally' and 'improving the balance sheet.' As measures in cooperation with Advantage Partners, with which it formed a business alliance in July 2025, it is pursuing projects in sales strengthening, solution strengthening, inventory optimization and M&A.

entries.a2c6cb630d3275e7: Centered on electrical discharge machines, the company handles everything from the development and manufacturing of machine tools to sales and maintenance services, and is expanding its product range into metal 3D printers, laser processing machines, injection molding machines and food machinery. It develops and manufactures in-house elemental technologies such as linear motors and incorporates them into its products. It has production bases in Thailand, China and Italy, and operates sales and maintenance service bases in North and South America, Europe, Greater China and Southeast Asia.
